_note: Answer key for evaluating Interview Insights on the synthetic Loop interviews. P1 = Sanne (interview-1), P2 = Daan (interview-2), P3 = Yara (interview-3). Evidence quotes are exact substrings of the transcripts.

pain_points.description: Repairs take far longer than promised, leaving people without their main transport

evidence.P2: it was more than a week before the replacement bike came
evidence.P3: the slot they gave me was a week later

pain_points.description: ID verification during sign-up fails repeatedly without explanation

counter_evidence.P3: It was fine for me, it took like five minutes.

evidence.P1: The ID check kept rejecting my passport photo

pain_points.description: Extra fees (damage, late return) come as a surprise and are not visible in the app

evidence.P1: Nobody told me that could happen.
evidence.P3: I had no idea that existed.

pain_points.description: Support is chat-only; people cannot reach a human when it matters

counter_evidence.P3: Through the chat, and to be fair it's fast.

pain_points.description: Battery range drops in cold weather, eroding trust

evidence.P2: since it got colder I notice it runs out much faster

pain_points.description: Subscription cannot be paused, only cancelled
Wants to see battery level on the phone (feature request)

evidence.P3: see how much battery I have left on my phone
The bike itself is really good.

should_not_appear.why: P2 explicitly says the lock works well
should_not_appear.trap: I've never had any trouble with the lock

should_not_appear.why: P1 and P2 both say the monthly price is fine or fair
should_not_appear.trap: The price is fair for what you get.

should_not_appear.why: P1 has no battery complaints; winter range is only P2
